description:
Port pi-agent-core — the stateful agent loop.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- Session GenServer + state struct (messages, tools, model, streaming flag, queues).
- Tool behaviour + registry.
- Loop Task (outer + inner loops matching agent-loop.ts runLoop:155-234).
- Parallel tool execution via Task.async_stream; sequential mode honored.
- Cancellation: Task.shutdown + cooperative AbortRef checked by tools/LLM stream.
- Steer + follow-up queues with "all"/"one-at-a-time" mode.
- Config hooks: `:before_tool_call`, `:after_tool_call` (mutation/block).
- Subscriber model: sync barrier subscribers + async PubSub.
- Transport pluggability via behaviour (direct vs proxy).

Definition of done: a test driver can register a trivial Echo tool and run the full inner/outer loop against Anthropic; abort mid-tool works; steer and followUp fire at the right boundaries.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.2, §4.5, §8.1, §6 Phase 2.
title: Phase 2: octo_pi_agent — kernel (Session, loop, tools)
